business_problem: Crisis Text Line offers text-based mental health support and crisis intervention in English and Spanish. With over 1.3 million conversations supported in the past year alone, the organization leverages advanced data and AI technologies to deliver high-quality training for crisis counselors.
solution_summary: Crisis Text Line built its Databricks implementation around Agent Bricks, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Unity Catalog, MLflow. Crisis Text Line offers text-based mental health support and crisis intervention in English and Spanish. With over 1.3 million conversations supported in the past year alone, the organization leverages advanced data and AI technologies to deliver high-quality training for crisis counselors. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. MLflow tracks model experiments and repeatable machine learning workflows.

evidence_quotes: As CTO Matthew Vanderzee noted, “We think about how we take all of the learnings from the knowledge we’re gaining around mental health and crisis response, and see how we can use that to support more people while influencing public policy a

Principal Product Manager Kristi Lui explained, “At the time, our data landscape was very siloed in terms of record reporting. A lot of business rules and context remained inconsistent or lost in data silos.

“Without that single source of truth, it was difficult to build a cohesive data culture across the organization,” Lui highlighted. The siloed nature of the infrastructure led to duplicated efforts across teams.
“Being able to manage access at the table and column level for all these different data profiles has been vital for our teams to move quickly, but with the proper oversight,” Lui said.
